candidates.statement: Payment service returns 503 on /v1/authorizations, causing order to fail and gateway /v1/checkout to return 502; payment is the failing dependency.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment metrics show zero counts in the 60s window, so the 503s are only visible in traces; underlying payment fault (config, saturation) not established.

report.explanation: Traces show inventory reservations succeed (200) while payment /v1/authorizations returns 503, propagating to order 502 and gateway checkout 502. Payment is the deepest failing hop; exact payment-side fault is not yet determined.
